component.summary: Development builds of the GNOME-based atomic desktop

description.p: ALT Atomic Onyx Nightly provides development builds of ALT Atomic Onyx, an image-based Linux distribution featuring the GNOME desktop environment.
Nightly builds may contain regressions or incomplete features and are not recommended for production environments.
